golden_source.title: Benchmarking Vendor-Guided Optimizations on Edge NPUs: From NPU Only to End-to-End Performance

scope: Numbered main sections and source-bound draft content. No paper-quality score, model benchmark, or claim that a draft has passed. Abstract and reference-list formatting are outside this first rubric.
basis_policy: C-prefixed rules are engineering safeguards we define. Other rules adapt observed writing practices and section_guidelines from the NPU paper; their operational pass conditions are our proposed policy, not an author-provided grading rubric.

applicability_policy.always: Apply whenever the corresponding draft section exists.
applicability_policy.conditional: Apply when the research scope includes this comparison or claim and relevant evidence exists. Missing evidence for a claimed result is needs_check, never not_applicable.
applicability_policy.unavailable_related_work: Do not invent citations. Keep related work pending or author-supplied and record this as a limitation of the draft.
applicability_policy.not_applicable: Requires an explicit scope reason; lack of a desired result or failed validation is not a valid reason.
do_not_transfer: the number of devices, configurations, workloads, RQs or subsections
NPU paper measurements, table numbers, author details or citations
accuracy or energy claims without this research's measurements

context_contracts.code: Plan, structured evidence index, approved numeric tuples, table objects and paragraph IDs. No model call for deterministic checks.
context_contracts.section_agent: Target section or subsection, its required items, applicable rubric rows, assigned evidence including conditions/limits and cited source excerpts; adjacent passage only when needed.
context_contracts.comparison_agent: Target result passage and both sides of the comparison, measurement definitions and matching conditions. Do not send unrelated experimental logs.
context_contracts.global_agent: Outline, RQ-to-section mapping, section briefs and claim/term index; request particular paragraphs if an inconsistency needs investigation. No full raw research diary by default.

evidence_required_for_met: evidence_ids where a research claim is involved
decisions.critical_rule: Applicable critical rules must pass/met. partial/missing/needs_check keep a draft candidate or require author review; they must not be silently called approved.
decisions.style_rule: Noncritical partial style findings remain visible; do not force endless rewriting.
decisions.repair_budget: Proposed policy: at most two targeted revision attempts per affected section. Not wired to the current global editor yet.
decisions.insufficient_evidence: Preserve a pending item and request author clarification; do not repair a missing experiment by generating prose.

criteria.pass_condition: Headings and their order match the plan; no model-added headings or missing body parts.
criteria.failure_action: Reject the affected body part and recompose headings in code.

criteria.pass_condition: Evidence markers exist and every cited ID belongs to the target section's assigned evidence. This does not prove every claim is cited or supported.
criteria.failure_action: Reject unknown IDs; request a local correction.

criteria.pass_condition: Section/item IDs are unique, generation order respects dependencies, and selected guides match section roles.
criteria.failure_action: Return a structured plan error before writing.

criteria.pass_condition: Each planned table has valid evidence IDs and consistent row/column shape, and model prose contains no independently generated table. Value correctness requires separate validation.
criteria.failure_action: Reject malformed or unsupported table objects; do not manufacture a table from prose.

criteria.pass_condition: Each linked guideline ID exists under a guide selected by that section. No cross-section or invented criterion IDs.
criteria.failure_action: Reject the invalid link before writing.

criteria.pass_condition: Referenced paragraph IDs exist in the specified section and required item checks cover every planned item exactly once.
criteria.failure_action: Reject the review response and retain the previous draft.

criteria.pass_condition: Reported numeric tuples match approved evidence. Sum/ratio checks run only when unit, scope and partition semantics are explicitly declared; ambiguous decimal commas or measurement scope become needs_check.
criteria.failure_action: Quarantine contradictory tuples; an agent or author establishes scope before any correction.
criteria.implementation: planned: generic draft numeric consistency gate; existing source-ID checks are insufficient

criteria.pass_condition: Assigned evidence retains provenance/writing_role and the passage does not promote plans, hypotheses or quoted advice into measured findings. Codes check metadata; an agent checks expression and attribution.
criteria.failure_action: Mark the offending claim needs_check and revise only that passage or withhold it.
criteria.implementation: partial: metadata and prompts exist; criterion-level gate not integrated

criteria.pass_condition: Explain the CUDA verification workload's motivation, the observed bottleneck and this study's focus with evidence; do not assert unsupported universal novelty.
criteria.failure_action: Revise the background/problem paragraphs or mark missing contextual evidence.

criteria.criterion: 비교 범위와 연구 접근을 서론에서 예고
criteria.pass_condition: Distinguish the actual measured scopes and comparison configurations. Do not silently equate CPU/GPU runs or kernel-only and total time.
criteria.failure_action: Clarify scope using assigned evidence; no forced three-configuration template.

criteria.criterion: 기여와 결과 요약을 실제 연구 범위로 한정
criteria.pass_condition: Summarize supported contributions/findings and outline the paper; align them with questions addressed by available data. The number of RQs is not fixed.
criteria.failure_action: Remove unsupported contribution claims or leave a research question pending.

criteria.pass_condition: Use this research's verified literature to compare relevant approaches by topic. Do not copy the NPU paper's reference list into the CUDA study.
criteria.failure_action: Keep related work author-supplied/pending when literature evidence is unavailable.

criteria.criterion: 선행연구와 이번 연구의 차이를 한정해서 설명
criteria.pass_condition: State what this study measures or separates relative to cited work, without claiming unverified first/best status.
criteria.failure_action: Narrow the comparison to supported literature or mark needs_check.

criteria.criterion: 실험 설계가 연구 질문에 답하는 이유 제시
criteria.pass_condition: Explain how the actual baseline, optimization branches and measurement scopes address the study's questions before implementation detail.
criteria.failure_action: Revise the design overview; do not invent a cumulative optimization sequence.

criteria.criterion: 실행 경로와 측정 시작·끝 지점을 정의
criteria.pass_condition: Define which stages each timing includes/excludes and distinguish launch/runtime timing, transfer, bound computation and total processing where measured.
criteria.failure_action: Mark undefined timing scope needs_check; do not relabel all timings as end-to-end.

criteria.criterion: 측정 절차와 통계량을 실제 기록대로 설명
criteria.pass_condition: Specify known warmup, repetition, synchronization and reported statistic; explicitly flag unknowns. Do not copy the golden's batch size, sample count or repetition counts.
criteria.failure_action: Request missing measurement metadata rather than fabricate it.

criteria.pass_condition: For each real version/branch, describe what changed and what stayed fixed, including precision, buffer, warmup or graph differences where recorded.
criteria.failure_action: Separate incomparable branches or label unknown shared conditions.

criteria.criterion: 단일 요인 효과와 복합 변경 효과를 구분
criteria.pass_condition: Do not attribute combined changes to one optimization unless a controlled comparison establishes that effect.
criteria.failure_action: Qualify the causal claim or describe a combined configuration effect.

criteria.pass_condition: Describe this study's network/input workload and recorded validation procedure. Distinguish single input and dataset execution; do not require classification accuracy or a fixed dataset size without evidence.
criteria.failure_action: Record unknown dataset or correctness evidence and block claims that depend on it.

criteria.criterion: 최적화의 실제 적용 위치와 범위를 설명
criteria.pass_condition: Link each discussed CUDA change to its implementation/execution scope; distinguish implemented code, trial branches and future plans.
criteria.failure_action: Remove unsupported implementation detail or change it to a pending plan.

criteria.pass_condition: Report known CPU/GPU, OS, CUDA/compiler/library versions; unknown fields remain explicit. NPU products and software are not transferred.
criteria.failure_action: Request environment information rather than fill plausible defaults.

criteria.criterion: 환경 차이와 실행 제어 조건을 비교 해석에 반영
criteria.pass_condition: If devices, clocks, hosts or execution modes differ, state those differences and limit absolute comparisons accordingly.
criteria.failure_action: Restrict the comparison or explicitly mark confounding conditions.

criteria.pass_condition: Explain which available evidence and tables answer each adopted question; do not require the golden paper's exact three metric tables.
criteria.failure_action: Revise the result overview without generating new experimental tables.

criteria.criterion: 질문에 먼저 답하고 비교 수치로 뒷받침
criteria.pass_condition: Give a scoped answer supported by matched configurations, units and timing intervals. Correctness claims require actual verification evidence; timing gains alone cannot establish correctness.
criteria.failure_action: Revise mismatched comparisons and withhold unsupported correctness claims.

criteria.pass_condition: Include material failures, slower variants, accuracy/verification uncertainty or inconsistent results that limit the claimed improvement.
criteria.failure_action: Add the relevant contrary evidence or narrow the claim.

criteria.criterion: 부분 구간 성능을 전체 처리 성능과 구분
criteria.pass_condition: When both scopes are measured, compare their relationship using the corresponding evidence. Do not infer total service speed or real-time guarantees from bound/kernel latency alone.
criteria.failure_action: Limit conclusions to measured scopes; mark unmeasured total performance pending.

criteria.criterion: 순위·가속비 비교에 공통 조건과 예외를 반영
criteria.pass_condition: Calculate or describe rankings/speedups only for comparable workloads and scopes, and explain exclusions or workload-dependent exceptions.
criteria.failure_action: Exclude unsupported cross-condition ratios and document the reason.

criteria.criterion: 추가 최적화 이득의 기준선과 범위를 제시
criteria.pass_condition: Show the actual before/after pair, units, workload and scope for a further optimization; do not force a staged narrative where experiments are separate branches.
criteria.failure_action: Replace an unsupported cumulative claim with separate observations.

criteria.criterion: 추가 이득의 원인을 관측과 가설로 구분
criteria.pass_condition: Distinguish measured improvement from proposed explanations; explicitly state simultaneous changes or unisolated causes.
criteria.failure_action: Qualify causal language and retain source attribution for interpretations.

criteria.pass_condition: State the study's actual workload/platform scope and known confounding factors, including warmup or run variance where recorded; avoid universal performance claims.
criteria.failure_action: Add the relevant limitations rather than generic boilerplate.

criteria.pass_condition: Identify relevant missing correctness, power, energy or real-time evidence when such claims are at issue. No claim of FP32 reliability or real-time achievement without supporting validation.
criteria.failure_action: Remove unsupported assurances and explicitly preserve pending verification.

criteria.criterion: 결론은 본문에서 확인된 발견만 범위를 지켜 요약
criteria.pass_condition: Summarize findings with their measured scope and trade-offs; introduce no new experiments, stronger causal claims or unverified numerical guarantees.
criteria.failure_action: Align only the offending conclusion passage with validated body claims.

criteria.pass_condition: Connect future work to stated gaps such as controlled experiments, input diversity, correctness or realistic execution conditions; mark it as future work.
criteria.failure_action: Revise the future-work paragraph with the known limitations.
